channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Egypt’s el-Sisi vows to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
item.description: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has vowed to take 'any measure' to defend Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks.

item.title: US and Iran both claim control of Strait of Hormuz amid attacks on vessels
item.description: Two vessels have been struck with naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz this week.

item.title: Russian strikes kill civilians, injure dozens across Ukraine
item.description: At least eight people have been killed and nearly 60 injured in the latest wave of Russian strikes across Ukraine.

item.title: Solar power booms in Philippines as war on Iran spikes energy costs
item.description: With Southeast Asia's largest electricity bills rising even higher, Filipinos invest in rooftop panels.

item.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
item.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

item.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
item.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

item.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
item.description: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in West Bank during olive harvest
item.description: Israeli settlers were seen attacking Palestinian farmers and setting fire to olive trees in the West Bank.
